summary: This is an SEC filing of a prospectus supplement for a $3,000,000,000 debt offering by the Province of Quebec. The filing describes the issuance of 4.625% Global Notes Series RI due June 3, 2036, with semi-annual interest payments. The notes are priced at 99.171% of par, with underwriting discounts of 0.175%, yielding net proceeds of $2,969,880,000. Delivery is through DTC and other clearing systems on or about June 3, 2026. The notes will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
